rust_summary: a mod's own picture in the HUD atlas (`native_mod_image`).
doc_summary: a mod's own picture: `native_mod_image(width, height, rgba)` uploads an RGBA image (each side at most 1024) into the HUD atlas slot `horizon/modimage`, drawn with `native_sprite` (its source rectangle crops and stretches it). The slot exists only while a native mod is loaded; false for an image of the wrong size or when there is no slot. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mod_image@.
